context_requirements: Active cell cycle progression with intact mitotic machinery
Expression of KIF11 (Eg5) and ability to assemble bipolar spindles
Functional spindle assembly checkpoint to sense monopolar spindles
TP53 pathway may modulate the apoptotic versus arrest outcome
falsifiers: No change in mitotic or proliferation landmark genes at 24 h in any cell line
Predominant G1/S gene expression changes rather than G2/M at 24 h
No evidence of mitotic arrest or apoptosis-related gene induction at 24 h
Strong transcriptional response at 6 h that is not sustained or amplified at 24 h

changes: Moved mitotic genes (CCNB1, CCNA2, AURKA, AURKB, BUB1B, PLK1, TOP2A, UBE2C, CDC20, NUSAP1, KIF2C, KIF14, KIF20A, MELK, MYBL2) from proximal_up to late_down because KIF11 inhibition causes mitotic arrest followed by transcriptional downregulation of G2/M genes, not upregulation.
Removed all proximal_up entries because no gene is directly upregulated by KIF11 inhibition; the primary effect is cell-cycle arrest and subsequent downregulation.
Kept late_up stress/apoptosis genes as they are consistent with prolonged mitotic arrest and TP53-dependent responses.
Set kinetics to slow and magnitude to weak at 6h and strong at 24h, consistent with the delayed transcriptional response to mitotic arrest.

Adjusted line_response: A375 and A549 to moderate due to TP53 status and epithelial/melanoma differences; MCF7 to moderate due to TP53 wild-type and estrogen-dependent growth; PC3 to moderate due to TP53 null and androgen-independent growth; VCAP to weak due to TP53 wild-type and slow growth; HA1E and HEPG2 to weak due to non-malignant/immortalized and low proliferation rates; HCC515 and HT29 to strong due to proliferative and TP53 mutant status.
Removed evidence list because no citations were provided.
